mission: Aftermath of the escape. Luke begins containing the fallout from a distance, calling in what favors he still has, while Dorrin becomes the strained official contact caught between “Ben may be right” and “Ben just helped a convicted prisoner escape.” Talon, exhausted and still defensive, gives Ben the next lead: Iressa Vossk.
why_now: Chapter 10 occupies the response phase and carries the next locked outline turn.
conflict: Talon should not joke much here. The valve is closed. He is tired, hunted, and being shown small kindnesses he does not know how to refuse. Ben should feel the weight of what he has just chosen.
turning_point: Act turn. Ben and Talon return to Coruscant together, compromised and hunted. Talon joins not out of gratitude, but because the attack proves the lie that ruined him was only one layer of something larger. # Act Two — Coruscant Investigation / Foundation / The Vigil Act purpose: Ben and Talon become a real investigative pair, Iressa’s death teaches Ben that restraint can cost lives, and the GAG trail leads through the Foundation, Korda, Tess, and finally to Iresh.

setting: Coruscant orbital approach, then a cheap civilian transit hub in a forgettable Coruscant district. Ben and Talon arrive exhausted from the prison escape. Holocall fragments with Luke (off-world, doing damage control from a distance) and the strained official voice of Dorrin. The hub is anonymous, neon-lit, and full of people who do not want to be noticed.
